text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — planning a serving runtime rollout tomorrow 2026-03-18 at 09:00 PT. This is the kernel engine bump + new quant profile (q4-v2) across the prod fleet. Need: deploy owner, smoke leads, and rollback readiness. :eyes:

Aj: I can own the deploy. Will do a staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 15m windows. Prep: image built, integration tests passed.

Sam: I’ll be on-call for the window and will run the smoke checks. Ping me 15m before start.

Rachel: Granting Aj the release tag rights and will trigger the rollout. I’ll monitor console dashboards and alerts.

Aj: Smoke checklist (short):
- verify canary nodes come up w/ kernel v2.1 and quant q4-v2
- run 20 short generation requests across models (chat, completion, embeddings)
- check p50/p95 latency not regressing >10%
- ensure KV cache warmup no errors
- confirm no OOMs on any instance

Aj: smoke commands:```bash
# test canary endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://canary.api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16}' | jq .
# tail logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime-canary -f --tail=200
# rollback (if needed)
redwood deploy rollback --env prod --release previous-stable
```

Sam: Will run those and paste the short results in thread. I’ll also run these quick checks against embeddings route.

Maria: Risk notes — quant q4-v2 improves memory but may change token-level probabilities slightly. We have eval set A (conversational) and B (summarization) to sanity-check. Aj: can you run a smoke eval set after canary?

Aj: Yep, will run eval A/B in the canary window and post diffs. If any metric drops beyond thresholds (exact-match drop >2% or rouge drop >3%), we stop and rollback.

Rachel: Rollout timeline: 09:00 start canary (5%). 09:20 -> 25%. 09:50 -> 100%. Finalize 10:30. If canary fails, we stop immediately and run rollback.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Deploy freeze window check passed for this org. No conflicting releases detected. :white_check_mark:

Aj: One operational note — kernel v2.1 requires a small kernel-args change in daemon config (`--max-kv-bytes=384m`). I'll push the config update to the canary first. If that looks good, we roll to stable.

Sam: I’ll watch memory and cuda-mem metrics closely. Also set an alert for increased tail latency (+20% p99).

Maria: OK, owners: Aj (deploy), Sam (smoke/oncall), Rachel (release/monitor). Action items:
- Aj: push canary config + run eval A/B during canary
- Sam: run smoke commands and post results within 10m of canary start
- Rachel: trigger canary and escalate if metrics break

Aj: noted. I’ll drop a short prep message 30m before start with the image sha and canary selector. :rocket:

Sam: 15m before I’ll post my phone # for pager escalation and standby.

Maria: Thanks — I’ll update the exec channel after final. Good luck. :thumbsup:
